title: Normalized K-flat descent of finite quotient pullback
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbb{Q}_{\ell}$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], schemes $X,Y$, a morphism $f:X\to Y$ and natural numbers $n\leq m$. Use the finite intrinsic exact pullbacks [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], the actual quotient extensions and their derived functors and universal K-flat models [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], and independent-coefficient K-flatness [def-pc-kflat-complex]. Given any natural isomorphism c between the cochain functors obtained by applying pullback at level m followed by quotient extension over X and quotient extension over Y followed by pullback at level n, and assuming pullback at level m preserves all K-flat complexes, there is a unique natural isomorphism between the corresponding two derived composites whose component square on every K-flat representative uses precisely the universal quotient-model homs, the exact-pullback factorization homs, and the termwise map of c. Write p,q for the two ordinary pullbacks, S,T for the derived quotient extensions over Y,X, respectively, phi_p,phi_q for exact-pullback localization factors and kappa_Y,kappa_X for the canonical quotient-model homs. For each K-flat P the required equation is e_(Q(P)) followed by Dq(kappa_Y(P)) followed by phi_q(s_Y(P)) equals T(phi_p(P)) followed by kappa_X(p(P)) followed by Q(c_P), where c_P is the component of the given cochain comparison. Finiteness of the coefficient quotients is supplied by [def-pur-finite-pullback-tensor-construction]. No boundedness, termwise flatness, constructibility or invertibility-of-l assumption is added.

proof.text: Transport each actual universal quotient counit from homotopy localization to cochain localization using derivedCochainCounit. The component identity for that transport and the identity quotient/localization factors identify its hom on any K-flat complex with coefficientFiniteQuotientModel.hom.

Use kflatWhiskering to obtain full faithfulness of restriction to K-flat representatives. More explicitly, resolve homotopy-category objects by K-flat complexes, apply resolvingRepresentativesFullyFaithfulWhiskering and restrict its fully faithful product restriction along the diagonal. Form two transformations on cochain localization: the exact source pullback factor followed by the target quotient counit and the given comparison c; and the source quotient counit followed by the exact target pullback factor. They are isomorphisms on K-flat representatives, the first by the given K-flat preservation hypothesis and the second directly by the quotient computation. Apply the existing normalizedComparisonDescent: full faithfulness lifts the ratio of the two invertible restrictions uniquely to an isomorphism of the derived composites.

Rewrite the two counit components as the prescribed quotient-model homs and reverse the resulting equality. The existence square and the uniqueness equation of normalizedComparisonDescent become exactly the stated normalization square. This works unchanged for m=n, n=0, zero complexes and empty schemes.

theorem finiteQuotientPullbackDescent {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m)
    (c : (sfIntrinsicPullback
        (finiteCoefficientRing l E (m + 1)) f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙
        (coefficientFiniteQuotientExtension l E X h).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ≅
      (coefficientFiniteQuotientExtension l E Y h).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙
        (sfIntrinsicPullback
          (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))
    (hgood : ∀ (P : CochainComplex (normalizedDVRModules l E Y m) ℤ),
      CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
        (R := integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y m) P →
      CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
        (R := integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E X m)
        (((sfIntrinsicPullback
          (finiteCoefficientRing l E (m + 1)) f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)) :
    ∃! e : finiteDerivedPullback l E m f ⋙ coefficientFiniteQuotientDerived l E X h ≅
      coefficientFiniteQuotientDerived l E Y h ⋙ finiteDerivedPullback l E n f,
      ∀ (P : CochainComplex (normalizedDVRModules l E Y m) ℤ)
        (hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
          (R := integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y m) P),
        e.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
          (finiteDerivedPullback l E n f).map
            (coefficientFiniteQuotientModel l E Y h P hP).hom ≫
          (sfIntrinsicPullback
            (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app _ =
        (coefficientFiniteQuotientDerived l E X h).map
          ((sfIntrinsicPullback
            (finiteCoefficientRing l E (m + 1)) f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app P) ≫
          (coefficientFiniteQuotientModel l E X h _ (hgood P hP)).hom ≫
          DerivedCategory.Q.map (c.hom.app P)
